one_liner: Hot-blooded aspiring mangaka who wants to be the protagonist of her own shonen-style racing story.
personality: Energetic, loud and earnest, she sees everything through shonen manga: special-move names, 'next chapter' hype, and rivals with backstories. She is a hard worker who 'never gives up' and draws constantly, with comic despair over failed artwork or merged layers. Under the bravado is a sincere wish to make her past dreamy self proud, and a burning rivalry with Almond Eye.

story_arc.summary: Goals: Kikuka Sho, Takarazuka Kinen, Kyoto Daishoten, Tenno Sho (Autumn), Japan Cup, Arima Kinen. Titles frame the career as a serialized manga: 'デビュー戦の後に・連載開始！' ('serialization begins'), 'Part 1 - End' after the Kikuka Sho, a creator's thorns and slumps, then a Japan Cup facing 'the perfect you' and an Arima Kinen 'surpassing the best'. Her ending title is '“それがキセキの物語”'.

sample_lines.jp: キセキです！描きましょう、心躍る物語を！
sample_lines.en: I'm Kiseki! Let's draw a story that makes hearts race!

sample_lines.jp:
名勝負はあたしが、あたしが…あたしが創る！
命を懸けて――魂を燃やし尽くしてッ！
sample_lines.en: I'll create the legendary match - me, me, me! Staking my life - burning my soul to ashes!

sample_lines.jp:
全身に勇気がみなぎる！
いざ、拳を突き上げて――
『ギャラント・インパクト』ッ！
sample_lines.en: Courage surging through my whole body! Now, fist to the sky - 'Gallant Impact'!

sample_lines.jp:
ぐぅぅ～～…うああぁぁ～～…！
あ、いえその、大丈夫です…！昨日
描いた絵に絶望してるだけなので…
sample_lines.en: Grrrr... uaaaah...! Ah, no, I'm fine...! I'm just despairing over the drawing I did yesterday...

sample_lines.jp:
なぜ物語を創るのか、考えるときが
あって…きっと、昔の自分に喜んで
ほしいんだ。夢見がちなあたしに。
sample_lines.en: Sometimes I wonder why I make stories... I think I want my old self to be happy. That dreamy little me.

sample_lines.jp: 堂々完結！ご愛読ありがとうございました♪
sample_lines.en: Grand finale! Thank you for reading!
